name: io.github.SQLazy/tabularium
title: Tabularium
description: Agent memory and a signed spending ledger: pay any x402 API, keep a provable receipt.

environmentVariables.name: TABULARIUM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 0x-prefixed EVM private key of the wallet that pays (use a dedicated wallet with a small USDC balance)

environmentVariables.name: TABULARIUM_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spend cap for this server process, in USD

environmentVariables.name: TABULARIUM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Service base URL (defaults to the public deployment)

environmentVariables.name: TABULARIUM_PAY_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: tabularium_pay: most one purchase may cost, in USD (ceiling 0.50)

environmentVariables.name: TABULARIUM_PAY_NETWORKS
environmentVariables.description: tabularium_pay: comma-separated networks it may pay on; default is the service's own network. eip155:8453 is mainnet (real money).

environmentVariables.name: TABULARIUM_PUBKEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional pinned Ed25519 signing key (hex) that exports must verify against
